issues.description: The template's ArrayHelpers defines a method named appendElement (appendElement(T[] array, T element)) but the template Stock class calls ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...). This name/signature mismatch causes a compilation error and prevents students from using ArrayHelpers as intended. The solution repository uses addElementToArray, showing the intended method name, while the provided template uses a different name (appendElement), so students starting from the template will be blocked by the unresolved method reference.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the ArrayHelpers API consistent: rename the method in the template ArrayHelpers from appendElement to addElementToArray (matching the solution and Stock usage), or update Stock.java to call appendElement. Ensure all references across the template use the same method name.

issues.description: The ArrayHelpers utility method name is inconsistent between template and solution: the template's ArrayHelpers class defines appendElement(...) while other code (template Stock.java) and the solution use addElementToArray(...). This breaks the conceptual mapping for students (they are told to use ArrayHelpers) and causes compile/runtime confusion because calls and definitions do not match.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the ArrayHelpers method name across artifacts. Rename the template ArrayHelpers.appendElement(...) to addElementToArray(...) (or change calls to use appendElement) so that method definition and usages match the solution and other code. Ensure ArrayHelpers.removeFirstElementFromArray remains unchanged.
